csv_scope_of_work: The Monroe County School District is seeking qualifications from experienced Architectural/Engineering (A/E) firms to provide comprehensive professional design services for the renovation and adaptive reuse of Bruce Hall, located at 1310 United Street, Key West, Florida. The project will transform the existing historic building into the District's primary administrative headquarters through comprehensive renovations, modernization of building systems, accessibility improvements, and space planning designed to improve operational efficiency. The building will be renovated to serve as the main Monroe County School District Administrative Headquarters.
